portability_test: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest uploads the RV-1 bundle and manifest through a standard-library AWS SigV4 path-style S3 client to a disposable S3-compatible compatibility endpoint, downloads both back, and verifies exact digests and bindings.
provider_diversity_claim_rule: Do not claim strict 3-2-1 backup while the current authoritative recovery locations are only the Production VPS and one independently operated non-GitHub S3-compatible external recovery store. A second non-GitHub provider or other independent recovery medium must be enrolled and verified before strict 3-2-1 is claimed.
three_two_one_target: Production VPS plus the current external S3 recovery store plus one additional independently operated recovery copy or medium; GitHub Actions artifact storage is not required.
